notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24786862/cc963501c51ff7e78e2f53d5a7bd3e44ef524760.jpg[/img]

Hi guys,

[url=http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en] From this page[/url] you can get access to our technical and commercial support. 
You can create a new account or use your credentials to log-in, then choose the correct section where you will be able to post your requests.

From our technical support you can report any problem concerning the use of our products, report bugs, inaccuracies or request assistance. From our commercial support you can request information regarding the release of our titles and DLCs, availability, supported platforms and contents of our games.

Our team will answer shortly.

[i]the Milestone Team[/i]

notes.title: Ducati Red Passion comes to life
notes.content:
[img]https://scontent-mxp1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/13087650_1710284652585024_7206389818691037871_n.png?oh=b7fd49c9eff3f345b8e209c86eff7d9b&oe=57B008C3 [/img]

Milestone and Ducati are glad to announce Ducati – 90th Anniversary The Official Videogame. The game will be available on digital store starting from June 1st 2016 for PlayStation®4, Xbox One®, the all-in-one games and entertainment system, and Windows PC/STEAM™.

Watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ncIJ9HMCEu8] TRAILER[/url]!


From the developers of RIDE and the Ducati Passion, comes to life Ducati – 90th Anniversary The Official Videogame, a spin-off fully devoted to the historical brand Ducati. Almost a century of legends packed into a single videogame!


There will be several contents included into this brand new title made by Milestone Studios. Race with the most iconic bikes thanks to 39 different bike models featured into the Game, whereof 29 new models. These vehicles will be divided into 7 big ERAS, from the ‘50s till the big victories, where you can find the bike of your dream . You can race and enjoy the power of the 125 Desmo (1958), 500 Pantah (1970), 70 F1 (1980), Monster 900 (1990), Monster S4RS Tricolore 848 (2000), 1199 Panigale Superleggera (Modern Era), Desmosecidici GP15 (Dovizioso) and much much more.

Racing the bikes is not enough, you need to grip the road with 5 countryside tracks (Parco dello Stelvio, Templi di Kanto, Sierra Nevada, Riviera Francese and Galles del Nord) and 8 Official circuit faitfully reproduced (Imola, Potrero de Los Funes, Alméria, Road America, Magny Cours, Donington e Sugo). There’s more. The game will feature a new exclusive track, the temple of the Italian Speed and the autodrome beloved by Ducati fans: Misano World Circuit – Marco Simoncelli. Relive the accomplishments of Ducati heroes.


Ducati is passion and history and here comes the exclusive Museum, for the first time included into a racing videogame. A space dedicated to fans and racing lovers who’s will have the chance to discover all the technical and historical details, and the curiosity that have made popular each vehicle.

The game modes will drive the player in a journey through the most relevant moment of Ducati history and for this reason it includes: – Two offline quick race game modes: Quick Race & Time Trial – An Online game mode with leaderboards to challenge the friends – The Ducati World Tour: this is the beating heart of the game that offer the chance to race on Single Race, Championship, Time Attack, Track Day and Head to Head for a deep and fueled charged Red Ducati experience.

What are you waiting for? Get into the history and live the Ducati Dream made by Milestone.

Continue to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/ducati90thanniversary/?fref=ts] Facebook[/url]!

Milestone Team
